𝗡𝗜𝗖𝗛𝗢𝗟𝗟𝗦 𝗧𝗢𝗡 𝗦𝗔𝗩𝗘𝗦 𝗡𝗭! 🇳🇿💯

Henry Nicholls hit a hundred as NZ recovered from 60/4 at lunch to 225/5 after 74 overs in Wellington.
Bumrah has 3 wickets.

Can India finish the job? 👇
#INDvNZ #Cricket
